unit_definitions.cell: one (question, judge, debater, condition) combination BEFORE transcript/side/replicate expansion; used only for grid bookkeeping in this document
unit_definitions.slot: one fully-expanded judgment unit (question, judge, debater, condition, transcript, side, replicate); the provider-billed unit
unit_definitions.completion_rule: every completion policy and completion gate in this protocol is defined at the SLOT level: 48,216 main-run judgment slots for the full roster, 2,016 canary slots (both derived below); never at the cell level

question_set.identical_to: phase2_protocol.json question_set (same three banks, same hashes, same 24 calibration exclusions, same 82 main questions)

transcript_reuse.policy: phase 3 makes ZERO debater calls. All judged debates are the phase-2 uncapped blind transcripts reused byte-identical: the budget affects only the judge, and the debater prompts never state a numeric budget, so transcripts are budget-agnostic by construction.

main_bundle.content: the 492 uncapped blind debate transcripts (82 questions x 2 self-play debaters x 3 transcripts) generated under phase-2 execution identity ba017fe3c6753a79236917b932b5434a8b99b9e2de37f0d32d4aca38f6613c1c
main_bundle.materialization: extract into a canonical transcript bundle with sha256; verify EVERY transcript (100% coverage, never sampled) against the phase-2 hash-chained result store before the bundle freezes; the manifest binds the bundle hash
main_bundle.verifier: the orchestrating assistant performs the 100% verification; the verification report (per-transcript hashes, source store event hashes) is a tracked artifact the owner can spot-check

canary_bundle.content: the phase-2 bridge-canary uncapped transcripts for the 24 held-out questions (one per question per debater)
canary_bundle.materialization: same 100% extraction-and-verification rule; if any held-out transcript cannot be verifiably extracted, generating a replacement canary transcript is permitted for the CANARY ONLY, recorded by amendment; main-question transcripts must never be regenerated

transcript_reuse.ingestion_mechanics: a phase-3 ingestion script pre-seeds the hash-chained cell-result store with rows for every transcript cell key computed under the phase-3 namespace by the same make_cell_key code path the plan enumerator uses, so the runner's completed-cell skip logic bypasses generation; a hard runtime assertion makes any attempt to reach live transcript generation for a phase-3 question a crash, never a silent provider call (see materialization_requirements.engineering_gates)

model_registry.price_note: prices are the phase-2 frozen registry values in USD per million tokens, carried forward for planning; ALL prices re-verified against a fresh provider snapshot at materialization; new-judge prices are unknown until that snapshot

judges_new.inclusion_rule: joins if and only if (a) it passes the canary calibration gates AND (b) the spend forecast method defined in decisions.spend.forecast_method, applied to its measured canary per-cell costs, projects total phase-3 stage spend within the stage cap with it included. The inclusion decision is recorded before main-run authorization and is not revisited afterward.
judges_new.cost_only_failure_rule: if it passes gates but fails the cost clause, it is excluded by mechanical application of the forecast method (recorded with the forecast's inputs and arithmetic), and the grid proceeds with 6 judges: 984 cells per condition, 41,328 total judgment slots (984 x 42)

roster.query_checker: google/gemma-4-31B-it under the phase-2 frozen checker config (sha256 8e674eddbb22ba73ee5a4ae4f359f1630cf4cd65c5f5d98cb70312dc868b9872)
roster.gate_reviewer: gpt-5.6-sol under the phase-2 frozen reviewer prompt (sha256 b48a125af874b287aa93e73671c9c12c9d8c4245d50e61013c690209139815f4), fresh isolated context per payload
roster.new_judge_failure_rule: a NEW judge that fails any canary calibration gate is DROPPED (not replaced; the 2026-08-14 availability check found no serverless same-family substitutes), its within-family descriptive pair is dissolved, and the roster proceeds with the survivors provided at least the four continuing judges remain. debate_grid.side_assignment: K2 mirrored; labels fixed across matched conditions, identical to phase 2
debate_grid.option_d_note: the doubled replicates at b4/b8 implement the owner-adopted Option D; the replicate index enters the seed derivation so the two replicates of a (transcript, side) slot are independent judge samples at temperature 0.3. Option D was adopted on an estimated tail-power gain; the verified gain from scripts/phase3_power_sim_optiond.py is an open_items_before_freeze input to the owner's confirmation.
debate_grid.dropped_from_phase2: batch_same_qa, placebo, capped debates, no-debate references, empty-evidence control, full-document anchors, AND with them the phase-2 secondary estimands C (cap-protection interaction) and D_clean (debate vs no-debate): all are settled phase-2 results, and phase 3 has no debater-side variation. Phase 3 is the sequential clean-oracle dose-response only.

primary_tests.confirmatory_criterion: Holm-adjusted two-sided p < 0.05 per contrast, over the family of four, is the SOLE confirmatory significance criterion. The simultaneous band is descriptive context and is never itself used to declare or deny significance.
primary_tests.reporting: the full four-contrast vector with per-contrast 95% percentile CIs, Holm-adjusted p-values, and a descriptive simultaneous 95% sup-t band
primary_tests.sup_t_band_construction: studentized maximum-modulus on the common draws: per bootstrap draw r compute m_r = max over contrasts j of |Delta_j(r) - Delta_j_hat| / se_j, where se_j is the bootstrap standard deviation of Delta_j over all draws; the 95th percentile of {m_r} is the critical value c; the band is Delta_j_hat +/- c * se_j for each j. Only B, the PRNG seed, and rounding remain for the analysis-pins artifact.
primary_tests.estimand_framing: intention-to-treat: the effect of GRANTING a budget under the frozen adaptive stopping policy (the judge may answer DONE early); queries_used is post-treatment and exploratory
primary_tests.population: all 82 main questions x all rostered judges x 2 debaters, subject to the D4/D8 population override in decisions.reviewer_throughput_fallback if the fallback triggers
primary_tests.weighting: within each (question, judge, debater, condition) cell, average all slots (6 or 12); then equal question, judge, and debater weights; the unequal slot counts across arms are a precision choice and never a weighting choice
primary_tests.inference: world-stratified question bootstrap resampling whole question clusters from the FULL 82-question population, with common draws across all contrasts. If the fallback triggers, the SAME draws are used for every contrast: each draw's D4/D8 statistic is computed by restricting that draw's resampled clusters to the frozen 41-question subset (per-draw subset counts vary, as in any cluster bootstrap; the subset is a fixed, pre-registered restriction, so this is a measurable function of the resampled data and preserves the cross-contrast correlation the sup-t band needs). No separate subset bootstrap is run.
primary_tests.invalid_policy: strict INVALID counts wrong (primary). Valid-only sensitivity with slot-level common support: a (transcript, side) unit counts as INVALID in an arm if ANY of its replicates in that arm is INVALID; a (transcript, side) unit INVALID in either arm of a contrast is dropped from both arms of that contrast, including all replicates; applied per contrast pair, uniformly across 1-replicate and 2-replicate arms

secondary_analysis.single_test: the least-squares slope of per-judge D8 on the judge's centered continuous capability anchor score, across the final rostered judges
secondary_analysis.inference: same common question-bootstrap draws: per draw, recompute every per-judge D8 and refit the slope; the anchor score is a FIXED covariate, never resampled. Two-sided percentile-bootstrap p; no multiplicity adjustment (family of one).
secondary_analysis.scope_of_inference: the CI is conditional on the fixed roster of judges actually run; it quantifies question-sampling uncertainty only and does NOT extend to the population of possible judge models
secondary_analysis.leverage_sensitivity: pre-registered leave-one-judge-out jackknife: the slope is refit excluding each judge in turn and the full set of refit slopes is reported alongside the primary secondary result, so single-judge leverage in a roughly-7-point regression is visible
secondary_analysis.attenuation_disclosure: the anchor is a 48-cell binomial score (24 questions x 2 mirrored sides), carrying roughly 6-8pp standard error per judge; classical errors-in-variables attenuation biases the slope toward zero. NO correction (e.g. SIMEX) is applied; the slope is reported as-is with this caveat.
secondary_analysis.power_honesty: with roughly 7 judges this moderation test is at best weakly powered, and anchor measurement noise attenuates it further; the confirmatory weight of phase 3 is the dose-response vector
secondary_analysis.trend_test_disposition: the proposal's optional trend-test secondary is NOT exercised; any trend or shape statistic is descriptive only, to keep the confirmatory surface minimal. Recorded in the authorization record as an assistant-resolved design detail under the standing delegation, flagged for owner review at protocol sign-off.

capability_anchor.question_set: the 24 held-out calibration-excluded questions ONLY; anchor items never overlap the 82 outcome questions
capability_anchor.cells: 24 questions x K2 mirrored sides per judge, temperature 0, capability_qa prompt from the reused phase-2 prompt bundle
capability_anchor.population: ALL rostered judges are re-measured under the phase-3 manifest, continuing judges included; phase-2 anchor scores are never pooled or substituted
capability_anchor.parser_rule: PREREGISTERED TOLERANT PARSE per the phase-2 parser policy's future_rule: after stripping leading/trailing whitespace, exactly 'ANSWER: A' or 'ANSWER: B' with at most one optional trailing period; anything else is INVALID and counts wrong. The strict no-period parse is reported as a sensitivity.
capability_anchor.timing: scored and frozen after roster freeze and before any phase-3 judgment outcome exists; runs inside the canary stage under canary authorization
capability_anchor.role: the continuous moderator in the single secondary test; also descriptive context. Parameter count is never a capability measure. Within-family pairs and any tier split are descriptive only.

review_volume_evidence.measured_phase2: 13,753 unique-payload gate rulings (E:/selvarath-archive/main-2026-08-06/main_reviewer_decisions.jsonl, hash-chained count) against 15,744 theoretical query slots in phase 2's two query-producing arms (2 conditions x 3,936 slots x 2 queries): observed yield 0.874 rulings per theoretical query slot, net of retries, early DONE, and dedup. Observed sustained review pace: 13,753 rulings between main-run start 2026-08-06T22:40Z and convergence 2026-08-11, roughly 3,000 per day through the nightly-refreshing reviewer quota.
review_volume_evidence.phase3_projection_method: theoretical query slots per judge per arm x 0.874 yield x an exhaustion factor bracket [0.65, 0.94] for b4/b8 (b2's measured exhaustion was 0.94; high-budget exhaustion is unknown and is a canary measurement), x judges

projections_at_7_judges.full_grid_option_d: 106,000-153,000 rulings, roughly 35-51 review-days at the observed pace
projections_at_7_judges.no_option_d_full_82: 59,000-85,000 rulings (identical query-slot totals to the previous row by coincidence of the arithmetic)

review_volume_evidence.dedup_unknowns: cross-arm and cross-judge payload overlap, and Option D replicate-pair overlap (two temperature-0.3 samples of the same slot may often produce identical query text), could reduce all projections materially; the canary measures replicate-pair and cross-arm dedup rates explicitly
review_volume_evidence.correction_note: the 20,000-ruling ceiling the owner selected on 2026-08-18 came from a flawed assistant projection that under-counted by roughly 4-6x; budgets 1 and 2 alone at the full grid consume about 14,000 rulings. The ceiling number is therefore VOID pending owner re-decision with these corrected figures; the fallback STRUCTURE below stands as decided owner intent.

reviewer_throughput_fallback.trigger_metric: blinded operational metric only: mean unique-payload gate rulings per slot per arm, measured in the canary; never any efficacy quantity
reviewer_throughput_fallback.projection_rule: projected total = sum over arms of (canary mean unique rulings per slot in that arm x main-run slot count in that arm) + the measured canary and anchor ruling counts themselves; audit-sampling reviews are human/owner-side and do NOT count against the reviewer quota or this ceiling
reviewer_throughput_fallback.ceiling_note: set by owner re-decision before freeze; the decision input is the corrected projections above plus the owner's calendar tolerance at the observed 3,000/day pace
contingency_ladder_on_trigger: step 1: restrict the b4 and b8 arms to the frozen 41-question subset below; D4 and D8 are then analyzed with their b0 comparator restricted to the SAME subset (paired), while D1 and D2 remain on the full 82; per-contrast populations are stated wherever the vector is reported. b1 is never dropped.
step 2 (if the projection still exceeds the ceiling): additionally drop Option D's second replicate at b8 only (b8 falls to 6 slots per cell; b4 keeps 12)
step 3 (if still exceeding): halt before main authorization and return to the owner; paid reviewing is NOT pre-authorized

subset_derivation.rule: half of the 82 main questions, stratified by (world, operational resolvability class), floor(n/2) per stratum plus largest-fractional-remainder to 41, lexicographic tie-break, within-stratum seeded draw without replacement in sorted-key order

query_screening.checker: the phase-2 frozen checker config, byte-identical
query_screening.retry_and_slot_policy: one free retry per attempted budget slot; a second rejection consumes the slot
query_screening.checker_failure_policy: outage, malformed output, or unresolved ambiguity halts the cell
query_screening.gate_review: the phase-2 dual-gate blinded review discipline, byte-identical reviewer prompt, unique-payload dedup documented
query_screening.audit_sampling_policy: human-review every rejection/retry and a deterministic world/resolvability-stratified 1% sample of accepted queries, blind to outcomes, unchanged from phase 2 and applied to the full phase-3 query volume; performed by the accepted_query_auditor named in external_assignments; audit reviews are outside the gate-reviewer quota and outside the throughput ceiling

execution_semantics.seed_policy: the phase-3 seed derivation includes question, transcript index, judge model, condition/budget, replicate index, debater model, and the protocol namespace. NOTE: phase 2's implementation (rejudge/config.py judgment_seed) omitted debater model and namespace despite its protocol text claiming otherwise; phase 3 extends the seed function to match this text (an engineering gate below), which is free of reproducibility cost because every phase-3 slot runs fresh under the new namespace.
execution_semantics.semantic_retry_policy: query-screen retry only; never regenerate an invalid verdict
execution_semantics.arm_order: randomize arm order within question; condition-balanced block scheduling so no budget arm lands systematically later under time-varying provider degradation
execution_semantics.statelessness: all judge calls stateless; caching keyed by request fingerprint; gate-review dedup by unique payload
execution_semantics.prompt_bundle: the phase-2 bundle reused byte-identical (sha256 cc02d29cfc8e7410c270c21f53da56457e44c31f74f8e512299e4e80726a076f); the sequential_judge_query template is fully parameterized by {remaining_budget}/{total_budget}, so budgets 1, 4, and 8 require no prompt changes
execution_semantics.transport_retry_policy: repeat identical request and seed; conservatively charge until provider reconciliation

spend.estimate_honesty: this prose range has no computed backing yet and two large opposite-direction corrections are unmodeled: phase 3 pays ZERO debater-generation cost (which dominated phase 2's blended per-cell average), while b4/b8 slots carry up to 8 sequential oracle turns with a growing judge context re-sent each turn (super-linear per-slot token cost) times Option D's doubled replicates. A computed phase3_cost_model.json against verified prices replaces this range before canary authorization; if its upper estimate exceeds 80% of the stage cap, the owner revisits the cap before canary authorization rather than discovering the squeeze mid-run.
spend.forecast_method: FROZEN FORMULA for every projection this protocol requires (Qwen3.7-Max inclusion, cap compliance): projected stage spend = sum over (model, call role, arm) of measured canary mean tokens-in/out per slot x verified per-token price x main-run slot count, evaluated at the upper bound of a 90% CI over canary per-slot token means, plus actual accumulated canary/anchor spend, plus a fixed 1.15 transport-retry multiplier on provider-billed calls (phase 2's observed retry overhead was below this). The method's inputs and arithmetic are recorded in the inclusion/authorization records that apply it. The method itself freezes with this protocol, before any judge-specific canary cost data exists.
